qualification.details: Each post has its own essential educational qualification, listed in the vacancy table above. For several technical posts, an ITI certificate or Diploma is required along with specific licences (such as a Wireman certificate for Electrician or an HMV licence for Technician/Mechanic-Drilling posts and Junior Driver). Where relevant post-qualification experience is required (for example, for Accountant, Technician-Survey, Technician-Sampling, Technician-Laboratory, Electrician, Machinist, Technician-Drilling, Mechanic and Mechanic-cum-Operator posts), it is counted only after passing the essential qualification, as on the cut-off date. Minimum essential qualifications are considered for all purposes; higher qualifications without the essential qualification are not considered. | The minimum qualifying marks in the essential qualification for all Non-Executive posts under direct recruitment is 45%. For qualifications like Intermediate pass of CA/ICWA and other certifications with no stipulated minimum marks, a pass is sufficient.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be placed in IDA pay scales ranging from Rs. 19,600-47,900 (Grade W-3, Junior Driver) up to Rs. 22,900-55,900 (Grade W-7, Accountant), with most Non-Executive posts falling in Grade W-4 with a pay scale of Rs. 20,200-49,300. Besides Basic Pay, MECL offers IDA, HRA, Perks & Allowances (under a cafeteria approach), PF contribution, Group Performance Related Incentive, Group Medical Insurance Facilities, the MECL-Employee Defined Contributory Superannuation Scheme (NPS), Group Personal Accident Insurance, Group Term Insurance, vehicle loan facility, and House Building Advance, as per Company guidelines.

selection_process: Selection for all posts follows a multi-stage process
with all tests conducted at Nagpur only:

Screening of applications: A Screening Committee segregates applications into "Eligible" and "Not Eligible" based on the information provided in the online application. Written Test (100% weightage): Conducted at Nagpur by an independent external agency notified as a "Public Examination Authority". Cut-off marks are 50% for UR/OBC-NCL/EWS
and a relaxed standard for PwD candidates as per government guidelines. Document Verification: Candidates clearing the written test are called for document verification
ordinarily in a ratio of up to 1:7 per vacancy
in order of merit. Skill Test / Trade Test (qualifying in nature): Conducted by an internal committee

which segregates candidates as "Suitable" or "Not Suitable". This stage does not carry marks toward the final merit list. Final Merit List: Drawn up based on Written Test marks among candidates found "Suitable" in the Skill/Trade Test
and approved by the concerned Functional Director.
how_to_apply: Visit the official MECL website at www.mecl.co.in and go to the "Careers" section, under the "Advertisement Notices & Results" tab.
Use the application link, which will be active only from 12.09.2026 to 11.10.2026.
Keep a scanned passport-size photograph and signature ready in JPG/JPEG format before starting the form.
Register on the portal and fill in all mandatory personal, educational, and experience details accurately, as shortlisting is based solely on the information entered.
Carefully select the correct category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwD/Ex-SM), as this cannot be changed later in the process.
Pay the application fee (if applicable) through the online payment gateway.

Upload the required scanned, self-attested documents (Aadhaar ID proof, driving licence where applicable, caste/community certificate, PwBD certificate, Ex-SM certificate, qualification mark sheets and passing certificates, 10th and 12th certificates, experience certificates, and other supporting documents) as per the specified format and file size (each set up to 500 KB in PDF).
Submit the application and retain a system-generated printout, along with payment details, for future reference.

Candidates should apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute technical issues; MECL has clarified it will not be responsible for failures to submit applications due to heavy website traffic or other reasons beyond its control. Only one application per post is allowed, and candidates cannot apply for more than one post under this advertisement.

faq.question: Q1. What is MECL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the official recruitment drive by Mineral Exploration & Consultancy Limited (MECL), a Miniratna-I Central Public Sector Enterprise, to fill 122 Non-Executive vacancies across 16 posts, as per Advertisement No. 03/Rectt./2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 122 vacancies are available across posts including Accountant, Technician (Survey, Sampling, Laboratory, Drilling), Assistant (Materials, Accounts, Hindi, IT, HR), Stenographer (English), Electrician, Machinist, Mechanic, Mechanic-cum-Operator (Drilling), and Junior Driver.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 11.10.2026. Online registration opens on 12.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MECL Non-Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post — ranging from 10th pass with a driving licence (Junior Driver) and ITI/Diploma qualifications for technical trades, to graduate and postgraduate-level qualifications such as B.Com, B.Sc., BCA, and Intermediate CA/ICWA for posts like Accountant, Assistant, and Stenographer. Full post-wise details are listed in the vacancy table above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 30 years as on the cut-off date of 01.09.2026, with age relaxation available for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwD, Ex-Servicemen, and other eligible categories as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MECL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General, OBC, and EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwD, Ex-Serviceman, and Departmental candidates are exempted from the fee.
